meta.title: Optical Emission Spectroscopy (OES)
meta.description: Starthermatech provides XHINS-OES optical emission spectroscopy complete system for plasma process monitoring and fundamental research. Non-intrusive species identification and temperature/density estimation, covering 200-1100 nm with 0.1 nm resolution, with equipment ordering and custom solution consulting.
page.title: Optical Emission Spectroscopy (OES)
page.lead: Non-intrusive spectral diagnostics for species ID and temperature/density estimates, suitable for online monitoring and research.
detail.title: OES System
detail.overview: Analyzes plasma self-emission without probes, for process monitoring and research. Covers 200–1100 nm, identifies species and estimates electron/excitation temperature and density.
detail.feature2: Identifies atomic/molecular/ionic species, estimates temperature and relative density
detail.feature3: Real-time, supports endpoint detection and QC
detail.feature4: Low cost, easy integration, auto reporting
